promotions.title: Activate Money Safe, Get a Pacific Coffee Voucher
promotions.highlight: ☕️ Receive HKD 30 Pacific Coffee e-Cash Voucher when you activate Money Safe
promotions.description: Deposit any amount into a Money Safe account and receive a HKD 30 Pacific Coffee e-Cash Voucher as a reward. To qualify, you must log into the EleBank App, activate the Money Safe feature, and deposit funds into this account. The voucher is available on a limited quota basis with a first-come, first-served policy. The Money Safe account offers the same savings and time deposit interest rates as regular accounts while providing enhanced fraud protection through anti-fraud features introduced by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. Funds in this account can only be unlocked through an in-person appointment, adding an extra layer of security against fraudulent transactions.
promotions.quota: Limited quota, first come first served

promotions.title: EleBank Visa Card Air Ticket Cash Rebate - Up to HKD 800
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Earn up to HKD 800 cash rebate on air ticket purchases with participating airlines
promotions.description: Cardholders using a registered eligible EleBank Visa Card to purchase air tickets from Air New Zealand, ANA, Ethiopian Airlines, EVA AIR, or Singapore Airlines via their designated official Hong Kong or Macau websites can receive substantial cash rebates. For a single transaction of HKD 8,000 or above, you earn HKD 800 cash rebate (maximum one per customer); for transactions between HKD 4,000 and HKD 7,999, you earn HKD 240 cash rebate. The promotion periods vary by airline, so you must check each airline's specific promotion dates and terms. Eligible cards must be registered with EleBank and used through the airline's official website to qualify for the rebate.
promotions.quota: Limited quota per airline; maximum one HKD 800 rebate per customer

promotions.title: Travel with Visa – Flight Booking Cash Rebate (HKD800 Maximum)
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Earn up to HKD 800 cash rebate on air ticket purchases with your Visa Card
promotions.description: EleBank Visa cardholders can earn cash rebates when booking flights through the official Hong Kong or Macau websites of Air New Zealand, ANA, Ethiopian Airlines, EVA AIR, or Singapore Airlines. Customers who charge a single transaction of HKD 8,000 or above receive HKD 800 cash rebate (maximum once per promotion period), while transactions between HKD 4,000 and HKD 7,999 receive HKD 240 cash rebate. The promotion period varies by airline, and the offer is available on a first-come, first-served basis with limited quota. Eligible cardholders must use their registered Visa Card to pay for the air tickets on the designated airline websites.
promotions.quota: Limited quota, first come first served

promotions.title: EleBank Visa Platinum Card with Transaction Protection
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Real-time fraud protection with 24/7 Shield Monitoring
promotions.description: The EleBank Visa Platinum Card offers comprehensive transaction security protection with its Shield Monitoring feature. This feature provides 24/7 real-time fraud protection to keep cardholders' transactions secure at all times. The card provides premium banking services with no limitations, allowing customers to enjoy stellar services regardless of their assets or status. Cardholders can apply directly through the EleBank app and manage their card alongside other banking services on the same platform.

promotions.title: EleBank 5-Minute Mobile Account Opening
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Open a bank account in as fast as 5 minutes via mobile
promotions.description: EleBank offers a streamlined account opening process that can be completed in as little as 5 minutes through your mobile device. This digital banking service allows customers to quickly access EleBank's financial technology ecosystem without visiting a physical branch. The bank continually innovates the banking concept to create stellar banking services shared by everyone. EleBank is a licensed digital bank approved by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, ensuring all services meet regulatory standards.

promotions.title: No Account Management Fees and No Minimum Deposit
promotions.highlight: 💸 No account management fees and no minimum deposit requirements
promotions.description: EleBank offers fee-free banking services with no account management fees and no minimum deposit requirements. This policy makes banking accessible to all customers regardless of their financial status or account balance. Customers can enjoy the full range of EleBank's digital banking services without worrying about maintenance fees or having to maintain minimum balances. This approach aligns with EleBank's mission to provide inclusive banking services to everyone, regardless of assets or status.

promotions.title: EleBank Personal Loan with Preferential Interest Rates
promotions.highlight: 💰 Personal loans up to 12x monthly salary with customized rates
promotions.description: EleBank offers personal loans with customized interest rates tailored to individual customers. Loan amounts can reach up to 12 times the customer's monthly salary or HKD1,000,000 (whichever is lower). The entire loan process, from application to fund disbursement, can be completed in as fast as 5 minutes. The actual annual percentage rate ranges from 7.43% to 35.05%, with repayment periods from 6 to 60 months. EleBank provides this 24/7 real-time service to meet customers' urgent financing needs.

promotions.title: Multi-Currency Savings Account with No Minimum Balance
promotions.highlight: 💱 Flexible deposit accounts with no minimum balance in multiple currencies
promotions.description: EleBank provides multi-currency deposit accounts with no minimum balance requirements. Customers can choose from flexible time deposit periods with the ability to open deposits 24/7. The service includes both demand deposits and time deposits in multiple currencies. EleBank also offers interest rate boost coupons that allow customers to earn additional interest on their deposits. Customers can manage their deposits conveniently through the EleBank app, with the flexibility to access their funds when needed.

promotions.title: Flexible Time Deposit with Interest Rate Boost Coupons
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Flexible term time deposits available 24/7
promotions.description: EleBank offers flexible time deposits that can be opened anytime through their 24/7 digital banking platform. Customers can choose from various term options to suit their financial needs. The service includes the option to use interest rate boosters to earn higher returns on deposits. This time deposit service is available to all EleBank customers and can be managed entirely through the EleBank app without needing to visit a branch.

promotions.title: 24/7 Multi-Currency Foreign Exchange
promotions.highlight: 💱 Round-the-clock currency exchange with real-time rates for 11 currencies
promotions.description: EleBank offers 24/7 foreign exchange services with real-time quotes, allowing customers to buy and sell currencies at any time. The service supports exchanges between 11 currencies including Hong Kong Dollar, US Dollar, and Renminbi. Transactions are processed instantly with funds immediately credited to the customer's account upon exchange. This service enables customers to take advantage of favorable exchange rates at any hour of the day without being restricted by traditional banking hours.

promotions.title: Multi-Channel Instant Transfers
promotions.highlight: 📲 Multiple transfer options including FPS and instant transfers
promotions.description: EleBank provides comprehensive transfer services supporting multiple currencies including HKD, USD, and RMB. Customers can transfer funds using various identifiers such as mobile numbers, email addresses, or account numbers. The service includes 24/7 instant transfers for HKD and RMB through the Faster Payment System (FPS). All transfer services are accessible through the EleBank app, providing convenient fund movement at any time.

promotions.title: Money Safe Deposit Protection
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Enhanced fraud protection for deposits while maintaining interest earnings
promotions.description: EleBank's Money Safe feature provides upgraded protection to help customers avoid fraud-related losses. This security measure allows customers to lock their funds while still earning the same interest rates as regular demand deposits or time deposits. The locked funds can only be accessed through an in-person appointment, adding an extra layer of security. This feature is part of the anti-fraud measures introduced by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority to protect customer deposits from unauthorized access or fraudulent transfers.

promotions.title: 24/7 Digital Banking Services
promotions.highlight: 🕗 Round-the-clock access to banking services
promotions.description: EleBank provides 24/7 digital banking services allowing customers to manage their finances anytime, anywhere. Customers can access a complete range of banking services including transfers, deposits, loans, and foreign currency exchange through a single app. The service includes 24-hour customer service hotline support for any assistance needed. This always-on banking platform ensures maximum convenience for all EleBank customers regardless of time constraints.

Funds can only be unlocked through an in-person appointment, providing an additional layer of security against fraud.

This service enables users to stay connected with family and friends across the globe through seamless financial transfers. The foreign exchange service is available 24 hours a day except during system maintenance or special circumstances.

promotions.title: Fusion Bank Foreign Exchange Time Deposit Interest Rewards

promotions.description: Fusion Bank offers special interest rewards for customers who exchange currencies and place them in time deposits. promotions.description: Fusion Bank provides round-the-clock foreign exchange services available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, except during system maintenance periods or special circumstances. This service allows customers to exchange currencies at their convenience without being restricted by traditional banking hours. Exchange rates are subject to market conditions and may fluctuate throughout the day.

promotions.title: Multi-Currency Account Service
promotions.highlight: 🌏 Transfer and manage HKD, CNY and USD from one account
promotions.description: Fusion Bank allows customers to make local transfers in multiple currencies including HKD, CNY, and USD. The service enables easy currency exchange and management from a single account.

promotions.title: Foreign Exchange Time Deposit Interest Rate Boost
promotions.highlight: 📈 Enhanced interest rates for forex time deposits
promotions.description: Customers who exchange foreign currencies can enjoy boosted interest rates on time deposits with Fusion Bank. This offer applies to various currencies including USD, HKD, and RMB with no upper limit on deposit amounts.
promotions.cost: Cost of currency exchange and minimum deposit amount

promotions.title: Foreign Currency Exchange Reward Promotion
promotions.highlight: 💱 Exchange currencies with real-time rates during service hours
promotions.description: Foreign exchange service available Monday to Friday (working days) from 9:00am to 5:00pm. Allows customers to exchange currencies at real-time market rates, though service will be suspended during Black Rainstorm or Typhoon Signal No.8 or above.

promotions.title: Foreign Exchange Rewards Campaign
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Special rewards for foreign currency exchange
promotions.description: Special promotion for customers exchanging currencies with Fusion Bank. The campaign includes benefits for exchanging between HKD, USD, and CNY with no upper limit on transaction amounts.

promotions.title: Fixed Deposit Bonus Interest for Foreign Currency Exchange
promotions.highlight: 💱 Special exchange rates and time deposit bonus interest
promotions.description: Promotional offer for foreign currency exchange featuring bonus interest rates on time deposits. Includes currency exchange between USD, HKD, and RMB with no upper limit on transaction amount.

promotions.title: liviSave Preferential Savings Rate Promotion
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn a preferential savings rate with no minimum deposit required
promotions.description: liviSave offers customers a preferential savings rate on funds deposited into their account. There is no minimum deposit requirement to open or maintain a liviSave account. Account opening is completed entirely online through the livi app without requiring complicated documentation. This is a permanent product feature available to all customers.

promotions.title: liviSave Account with No Fees and No Minimum Deposit
promotions.highlight: 🆓 Open a liviSave account with no fees and no minimum deposit
promotions.description: liviSave accounts charge no fees for account maintenance or transactions. There is no minimum deposit balance required to open or keep the account active. The account is designed for both everyday payments and savings needs. Account opening is quick and easy, completed entirely online through the mobile app.

promotions.title: Instant Transfers with FPS (Faster Payment System)
promotions.highlight: ⚡ Fast and free transfers to anyone at any time with FPS
promotions.description: livi provides instant transfers to any recipient at any time using the Faster Payment System (FPS). Transfers are completely free with no transfer fees charged. Funds can be sent anytime, anywhere through the livi mobile app. This is a permanent service feature available to all livi customers.

promotions.title: Pay with livi – QR Payment Service
promotions.highlight: 🔐 Fast and secure QR payment accepted by merchants across Hong Kong
promotions.description: livi offers QR code payment functionality that is fast and secure, accepted at merchants throughout Hong Kong. Customers can use QR payments for everyday purchases at any participating merchant location. This is a permanent core banking feature available to all livi account holders.

promotions.title: livi Rewards Program - Happiness
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Enjoy special rewards and benefits with livi Rewards
promotions.description: livi Rewards offers special benefits and perks to livi bank customers. The program provides various rewards that can be redeemed by customers who use livi's banking services. While specific details of the rewards are not provided, this program appears to be a customer loyalty initiative designed to enhance the banking experience. Customers can likely access and manage these rewards through the livi app.

promotions.title: Universal Voyage Travel Insurance Plan
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Comprehensive travel insurance coverage for your journeys
promotions.description: The Universal Voyage Travel Insurance Plan offers protection during your travels. This insurance product is available to livi bank customers looking for travel coverage. The plan likely includes standard travel insurance benefits such as medical coverage, trip cancellation, lost baggage, and other travel-related protections. Customers can purchase this insurance through the livi app before their trips to ensure they have adequate protection while traveling.

promotions.title: Easy HomeCare Insurance
promotions.highlight: 🏠 Protection for your home and belongings
promotions.description: The Easy HomeCare insurance plan provides coverage for your home and personal belongings. This insurance product is available to livi bank customers who own or rent homes. The plan likely covers risks such as fire, theft, water damage, and other common household perils. Customers can purchase this insurance through the livi app to protect their homes and valuables against unexpected damages or losses.

promotions.title: Pet Care Insurance
promotions.highlight: 🐾 Insurance coverage for your beloved pets
promotions.description: Pet Care insurance offers protection for your pets' health and wellbeing. This insurance product is available to livi bank customers who own pets. The plan likely covers veterinary expenses, accidents, illnesses, and potentially other pet-related emergencies. Customers can purchase this insurance through the livi app to ensure their pets receive necessary medical care without financial strain during unexpected health issues.
promotions.cost: Premium varies based on pet type and coverage

promotions.title: livi Flexi Loan - Personal Loan
promotions.highlight: 💸 Flexible personal loan options for various needs
promotions.description: livi Flexi Loan offers personal loan services with flexible terms and conditions. This loan product is available to eligible livi bank customers who meet the bank's credit requirements. The Flexi Loan appears to be designed with customizable features to meet different financial needs and circumstances. Customers can likely apply for this loan through the livi app and receive personalized loan offers based on their credit profile.

promotions.title: livi Flexi Loan - Balance Transfer
promotions.highlight: 💳 Transfer balances from other loans or credit cards
promotions.description: livi Flexi Loan Balance Transfer allows customers to consolidate debt from other financial institutions. This service is available to eligible livi bank customers who wish to transfer their outstanding balances from other loans or credit cards. The Balance Transfer option likely offers competitive interest rates to help customers manage their debts more effectively. Customers can apply for this service through the livi app and potentially save on interest payments compared to their existing loans.

promotions.title: livi Business SME Financing
promotions.highlight: 💰 Financing solutions for small and medium enterprises
promotions.description: livi Business SME Financing offers loan and credit facilities for small and medium-sized businesses. This financing option is available to eligible SMEs that meet livi bank's credit criteria. The SME financing solution likely includes various funding options such as working capital loans, equipment financing, or business expansion loans. Business owners can apply for these financial solutions through livi's business banking platform to support their company's growth and operational needs.

promotions.title: BOC Chill Card
promotions.highlight: 💳 Special card offering unique benefits
promotions.description: The BOC Chill Card offers payment capabilities with special features. This card is available to eligible livi bank customers who apply and meet the qualification criteria. While specific details are not provided, the card likely includes benefits such as rewards, discounts, or special privileges at participating merchants. Customers can apply for this card through the livi app to enjoy its unique features and enhance their spending experience.

promotions.title: BOC Mastercard® Debit Card
promotions.highlight: 💳 Mastercard debit card for global acceptance
promotions.description: The BOC Mastercard Debit Card provides global payment capabilities and wide acceptance. This debit card is available to eligible livi bank customers with active accounts. The Mastercard debit card enables customers to make purchases at millions of locations worldwide where Mastercard is accepted, as well as online shopping and ATM withdrawals. Customers can apply for this card through the livi app to access their funds conveniently for everyday spending.

promotions.title: livi QR Cash Withdrawal
promotions.highlight: 💵 Withdraw cash using QR codes for convenience
promotions.description: Access cash withdrawals using QR codes for a convenient banking experience. This service is available to all livi bank customers with an active account. The QR Cash feature allows customers to withdraw money without traditional ATM cards by using QR codes generated in the livi app. This provides a secure and modern alternative to conventional cash withdrawal methods, enhancing customer convenience and accessibility to their funds.

promotions.title: livi Business Account
promotions.highlight: 💼 Business banking solutions for companies
promotions.description: livi Business Account provides banking services tailored for business needs. This account is available to eligible businesses that meet livi bank's requirements. The business account likely includes features such as business transactions, payment processing, and other financial management tools designed for commercial use. Business owners can open and manage these accounts through livi's business banking platform to handle their company's financial operations efficiently.

promotions.title: livi Account Opening - 100% Online Process
promotions.highlight: 📱 Quick and easy 100% online account opening
promotions.description: Open a livi bank account completely online without complicated documents. The process is quick and easy, allowing customers to join anytime, anywhere through the app.

promotions.title: Digital Account Opening in Minutes
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ 100% online account opening - quick and easy
promotions.description: Open a livi account completely online without complicated documents. The process is quick and easy, allowing you to start banking from anywhere at any time through the app.

promotions.title: Tax Deduction for Wang Fuk Court Support Fund Donations
promotions.highlight: 💝 Special tax deduction arrangement for Support Fund donations
promotions.description: Donations made to the Support Fund for Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po through bank transfer with an amount of HK$50,000 or below are eligible for tax deductions without requiring official receipts. Donors need to retain relevant donation records for potential review by the Inland Revenue Department.

promotions.title: liviSave No Minimum Balance
promotions.highlight: 💸 No fees and no minimum deposit requirements
promotions.description: Open a liviSave account without worrying about fees or minimum balance requirements. This account caters to both paying and saving needs, offering complete flexibility for customers.

promotions.title: Money Safe Rewards
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Special rewards for keeping your money safe
promotions.description: livi offers 'Money Safe Rewards' (智安存獎賞) program that provides benefits to customers for maintaining security measures. This program rewards customers for practicing safe banking habits.

promotions.title: No Minimum Deposit Requirement
promotions.highlight: 🆓 No fees and no minimum balance requirements
promotions.description: Open and maintain a liviSave account with no minimum deposit requirement and no maintenance fees. This feature makes the account accessible to everyone regardless of their financial situation.

promotions.title: Instant Loan with Interest Rate as Low as 1.18% and up to HKD10,888 Cash Reward
promotions.highlight: 💰 Get attractive rates as low as 1.18% plus earn up to HKD12,888 cash reward on designated Instant Loans
promotions.description: From now until 31 July 2026, customers who successfully apply for designated Instant Loan products can enjoy up to HKD12,888 in cash rewards. The application process is quick and convenient through the Mox app, offering personalised quotations and instant disbursement. Rates start as low as 1.18%, providing competitive borrowing terms. Customers can apply entirely through the Mox mobile app for a seamless experience.

promotions.title: Xiaomi Shopping Rewards with up to 7% Total Cash Rewards and 0% Instalments
promotions.highlight: 📱 Earn up to 7% total cash rewards (up to 5% extra rebate capped at HKD450 plus 2% unlimited cashback) plus up to 12-month 0% instalments at Xiaomi
promotions.description: New Mox Credit customers can earn up to 7% total cash rewards when shopping at mi.com or any Xiaomi Store using their Mox Credit Card. Specifically, customers receive up to 5% extra cash rebate (capped at HKD450) when hitting the required cumulative spend threshold, plus the standard up to 2% unlimited cashback on all spending. Additionally, customers enjoy up to 12-month 0% interest instalments on their Xiaomi purchases. New customers who sign up with invitation code XM1500MOX earn up to HKD2,150 in cash rewards, with an extra HKD2,150 available as a new customer bonus.

promotions.title: Mox Invest Journey from Scratch – Scratch Cards with Prize Up to HKD8,888
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Complete 5 missions to scratch and win up to HKD8,888 (HKD8,000 Solana + HKD888 cash)
promotions.description: During the promotional period from 16 March 2026 to 15 June 2026, Mox Invest customers can complete any of five simple challenges to earn Mox Scratch Cards. Each completed mission grants you a scratch card with instant prize reveal. Finishing more missions multiplies your chances to win the top prize of HKD8,888 (HKD8,000 SOL Solana cryptocurrency plus HKD888 cash reward). The quota is limited and allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. Please note that investment involves risks and Mox Invest Terms and Conditions apply.

promotions.title: Mox x csl Best-in-Town Exclusive Plan Offer – Up to HKD1,380 Rebates Plus Free NowTV Pass
promotions.highlight: 🤳 Get HKD180 monthly fee rebate plus a free Now TV beIN SPORTS Super Pack 1-Month Pass (valued at HKD188)
promotions.description: Mox x csl offers an exclusive plan promotion where customers can sign up for a new csl plan or renew an existing one with Mox Credit Card autopay setup. Upon completion, customers automatically enjoy an HKD180 monthly fee rebate plus a free Now TV beIN SPORTS Super Pack 1-Month Pass valued at HKD188. This provides both connectivity and entertainment benefits in one integrated offer. The rebate applies monthly, and the free Now TV pass enhances the overall value of the promotion.
promotions.cost: New csl plan or renewal with Mox Card autopay

promotions.title: Mox Travel Pick & Go Insurance – Free Add-on Coverage Promotion
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Apply for Travel Pick & Go insurance and receive 1 FREE add-on coverage (Eggstra Care+)
promotions.description: From 4 March to 31 May 2026, customers applying for Mox Travel Pick & Go insurance can receive 1 free add-on coverage called Eggstra Care+. This free add-on helps safeguard your trip by providing additional protection from unexpected financial stress during travel. The promotion is designed to enhance travel insurance coverage at no extra cost during the specified three-month period. This offer is part of Mox's commitment to supporting travellers' peace of mind.

promotions.title: Mox MOXTRAVEL Welcome Offer – Earn Up to 28,500 Asia Miles
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Earn up to 28,500 Asia Miles through spending and saving - enough for a round-trip flight to Asia
promotions.description: From now until 30 June 2026, new customers who enter invitation code "MOXTRAVEL" to open a Mox account and apply for a Mox Credit Card can earn up to 28,500 miles through spending and saving activities. This miles accumulation is sufficient to cover a round-trip flight to most Asian destinations, making it ideal for travellers. Miles are earned through both spending on the Mox Credit Card and maintaining savings deposits. This offer is exclusively available to new Mox customers who have not previously held a Mox Account.

promotions.title: MOXPAYROLL Invitation Code - Earn up to HKD1,600 for Payroll Customers
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Earn up to HKD1,600 with MOXPAYROLL code: HKD400 upon card approval plus HKD600 for each month of payroll deposits
promotions.description: Open a Mox Account using invitation code "MOXPAYROLL" by 30 June 2026, and once your credit card is approved within the following 30 days, you earn HKD400 immediately. Additionally, accumulate eligible payroll transactions in May and June 2026 to earn HKD600 each month, totaling up to HKD1,600 in cash rewards. This offer is exclusively for customers who have not held any Mox Account in their name during the 12 months prior to the onboarding date. Eligible payroll transactions are those where your employer pays your salary into your Mox Account via FPS.
promotions.quota: New customers only who have not held a Mox Account in the past 12 months

promotions.title: Mox MOXDEPO Welcome Offer – HKD2,500 Cash Reward for Time Deposit
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn HKD2,500 cash reward when you place a time deposit of at least HKD250,000
promotions.description: From now until 30 June 2026, new customers using invitation code "MOXDEPO" can earn HKD2,500 cash rewards. Complete your account opening within 15 days, place a Time Deposit of at least HKD250,000 within 7 days, and maintain this balance until the end of the Hold Fund Period to receive the full reward. The reward is credited directly to your Mox Account once all conditions are met. This offer is exclusively for customers who have not held any Mox Account in their name during the 12 months prior to the onboarding date.
promotions.quota: New customers only who have not held a Mox Account in the past 12 months

promotions.title: Mox Spend & Save Double Rewards – 20% Cash Rebate from 5 Merchants Plus Savings Rewards
promotions.highlight: 🎯 Build wealth through daily spending — earn direct stock rewards instead of points via StockBack x ZA Card
promotions.description: ZA Bank's StockBack program permanently allows cardholders to earn direct stock rewards on everyday card spending rather than traditional loyalty points. Customers accumulate stocks through normal spending and build personalized reward packages via daily transactions. This is a core card reward feature with no expiry date and permanent availability to all ZA Card holders.
promotions.quota: All ZA Card holders; no limit

promotions.title: Mox MOXHKT25 Welcome Offer - Up to HKD1,400 Rewards + Mega Football Event Pass Discount
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Earn up to HKD1,400 rewards including 2,000 Clubpoints + HKD1,000 cash + HKD200 discount for Mega Football Event Pass
promotions.description: From 13 May to 30 June 2026, new customers opening a Mox Account with invitation code "MOXHKT25", linking their Mox Card to The Club Account, and applying for a Mox Credit Card receive multiple rewards: instantly 2,000 Clubpoints (equivalent to HKD400 based on current conversion), HKD1,000 cash reward for spending HKD1,000 in one transaction at csl Shop or 1O1O Center or via HKT service subscription within 30 days of card approval, and a HKD200 discount code for the Now TV 2026 Mega Football Event Pass. Additionally, enjoy up to 2% Unlimited CashBack on all spending with no cap or category limits. The total value can reach HKD1,400 when combining the Clubpoints valuation with cash rewards.
promotions.quota: New customers only, limited quota, first come first served
promotions.cost: HKD1,000 spending requirement for cash reward

promotions.title: Xiaomi Exclusive Offer – Up to 7% Total Cash Rewards with Mox Credit Card
promotions.highlight: 📱 Earn up to 7% total cash rewards at Xiaomi plus 0% instalments and up to HKD2,150 cash bonus for new customers
promotions.description: New Mox customers can earn up to HKD2,150 in cash bonus by signing up with invitation code XM1500MOX. When shopping at mi.com or any Xiaomi Store with your Mox Credit Card, you can unlock up to 5% extra cash rebate (capped at HKD450) plus up to 12-month 0% interest instalments when meeting cumulative spending requirements. Combined with the standard up to 2% Unlimited CashBack, this creates a total of up to 7% in cash rewards. New customers receive the HKD2,150 cash bonus upon account opening with the specified invitation code.

promotions.title: Mox Invest 0% Fund Subscription Fee (All Fees Waived)
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Enjoy 60 days of unlimited zero-fee trading: 0% stock buy commission, 0% crypto buy commission, 0% fund subscription fee
promotions.description: New Mox Invest customers receive 60 days of unlimited zero-fee perks including 0% stock buy commission, 0% crypto buy commission, and 0% fund subscription fees. To qualify, you must successfully open a Mox Invest account starting from 8 May 2026 to instantly unlock these benefits. Other fees such as settlement fees, stamp duty, trading fees, transaction levies, annual management fees, and custodian fees continue to apply. This promotion is valid from 8 May 2026 to 30 June 2026 and is available to new Mox Invest customers only.

promotions.description: New customers who use invitation code "1500MOX" to open a Mox account and apply for a Mox Credit Card can earn up to HKD1,500 in cash rewards by meeting spending requirements at any merchant in Hong Kong. An additional HKD200 cash reward is available when spending on electronics and electronic products. You also unlock 2% Unlimited CashBack or Unlimited Asia Miles with no balance requirement, allowing you to earn on every daily spend everywhere. This promotion runs until 30 June 2026.

promotions.title: Mox Credit x csl Best-in-Town Exclusive Plan Offer
promotions.highlight: 📱 Get up to HKD1,380 monthly fee rebates (HKD180/month × 24 months) plus free Now TV beIN SPORTS Super Pack 1-Month Pass
promotions.description: Mox Credit Card customers who sign up for a new csl plan or renew their existing plan with Mox Credit Card autopay set up receive an HKD180 monthly fee rebate plus a free Now TV beIN SPORTS Super Pack 1-Month Pass (valued at HKD188). This automatically upgrades both your connectivity and entertainment in one package. The offer provides long-term savings of HKD1,380 over a 24-month commitment (HKD180 rebate × 12 months = HKD2,160 annually, though the exact annual cap is not specified). All eligible Mox Credit Card customers can take advantage of this exclusive arrangement with csl.

promotions.title: Mox Journey from Scratch – Crypto Scratch Card Promotion
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Complete 5 missions to get 5 scratch cards with chances to win up to HKD8,888 (HKD8,000 SOL + HKD888 cash)
promotions.description: During the promotional period from 16 March 2026 to 15 June 2026, Mox Invest customers can take on any of five simple challenges to earn a Mox Scratch Card. Scratch each card to reveal your prize instantly and have multiple chances to win the top prize of HKD8,888 (HKD8,000 worth of Solana (SOL) plus HKD888 cash reward). Quota is limited and operates on a first-come, first-served basis. Investment involves risks.

Completing any or all of these missions instantly activates the bonus rate, which remains in effect until the end of the month. This tiered approach allows customers to progressively increase their interest rate based on their level of engagement with Mox services.

This ongoing program is subject to terms and conditions that detail the specific rewards and qualification criteria.

promotions.title: 2% Unlimited CashBack or HKD4=1 Mile Reward
promotions.highlight: 💳 Earn up to 2% Unlimited CashBack on all spending with no category limits
promotions.description: Maintain a total eligible balance of HKD250,000 or more to enjoy up to 2% Unlimited CashBack on all spending with no cap or category limits. For example, a single transaction of HKD10,000 can earn up to HKD200 in cash rewards instantly.

promotions.title: Spending Rewards Switching Fee Waiver
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Free switching between CashBack and miles rewards with HKD250,000+ balance
promotions.description: Switching fee between CashBack and miles rewards is waived if you have an Eligible Balance for Card Rewards of HKD250,000 or above at the time of switching. After April 1, 2026, a HKD50 fee may apply unless you have Mox+ status.

promotions.title: Mox Zone Year-Round Electronics Discounts
promotions.highlight: 🛍️ Access exclusive discounts on 100+ popular electronics all year round
promotions.description: Mox Zone offers year-round exclusive discounts on over 100 popular electronics products. Available to all Mox customers with no time limit or special requirements, making it a permanent feature for smart shoppers looking for electronics deals.

promotions.title: 0% Foreign Currency and Overseas Merchant Spending Fees
promotions.highlight: 🌍 Pay 0% foreign exchange fees when spending overseas or in foreign currencies
promotions.description: Mox Credit Card users can enjoy 0% foreign exchange handling fee and cross-border access fee when making purchases in foreign currencies or at overseas merchants. This makes international spending more cost-effective.

promotions.title: CLUBLINK Invitation Code The Club Offer
promotions.highlight: 💰 HKD1,000 cash reward for The Club or Club Travel spending
promotions.description: Open a Mox Account using invitation code CLUBLINK and spend HKD1,000 or more on The Club or Club Travel platforms with Mox Credit Card within 30 days to receive a cash reward of HKD1,000, credited directly to your Mox Account.
promotions.quota: Limited quota, first come, first served
promotions.cost: Minimum spend of HKD1,000 on The Club or Club Travel

promotions.title: Personal Accident Cushion Insurance Offer
promotions.highlight: ⚡️ Up to 2 months of premium rebate with Personal Accident Cushion
promotions.description: Purchase Personal Accident Cushion insurance and enjoy up to 2 months of premium rebate during the promotional period. Double the standard reward for enhanced savings.
promotions.cost: Purchase of Personal Accident Cushion insurance required

promotions.title: Payroll with Mox Top-up Promotion
promotions.highlight: 💰 Get 1.5% p.a. on savings & 2% CashBack with payroll setup
promotions.description: Set up payroll with Mox and receive a 1.5% p.a. top-up on your savings interest rate. Additionally, enjoy Unlimited 2% CashBack on all Mox Credit Card spending without additional requirements.

promotions.title: Mox Referral Programme
promotions.highlight: 🎉 Earn HKD300 for each successful referral
promotions.description: Share your referral code to invite friends to join Mox. Both you and your friend earn HKD300 cash reward each when your friend successfully opens a Mox account, applies for a Mox Credit Card, and completes HKD1,000 eligible spending.
promotions.quota: No limit on number of referrals
promotions.cost: Free to refer, friends must complete HKD1,000 eligible spending

promotions.title: Mox Asia Miles Time Deposit
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Earn Asia Miles with Time Deposits
promotions.description: Mox offers a special Time Deposit product that allows customers to earn Asia Miles instead of traditional interest. A permanent feature that helps customers save money while accumulating miles for future travel.

promotions.title: FlexiBoost Savings Account
promotions.highlight: 💰 Enjoy flexibility and competitive rates with FlexiBoost savings
promotions.description: FlexiBoost savings account offers unmatched flexibility with competitive interest rates. A permanent feature that allows customers to grow their savings while maintaining liquidity when needed.

promotions.title: New FX Users Cash Rewards
promotions.highlight: 💱 Earn up to HKD175 cash rewards as new FX user
promotions.description: New Mox FX users can earn up to HKD175 in cash rewards when they start using the foreign exchange services. Rewards are given for completing initial FX transactions.

promotions.title: Instant Earnings on Deposits
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Enjoy instant interest earnings on deposits
promotions.description: Mox offers instant interest earnings on deposits without waiting periods. Interest is calculated daily and credited to accounts immediately, allowing customers to maximize their returns from day one.

promotions.title: Mox Credit Asia Miles Conversion Rate
promotions.highlight: ✈️ HKD4=1 mile + 0 Limits + 0% FX Fees
promotions.description: Mox Credit Card offers a permanent miles program where all spending earns 1 mile for every HKD4 spent with no limits. Includes 0% foreign currency transaction fees, making it ideal for travel spending.

promotions.title: 0% Interest Instant Clear
promotions.highlight: 💸 Enjoy 0% interest on Instant Clear loans
promotions.description: Mox offers 0% interest on Instant Clear loans during the promotional period. This allows customers to access funds quickly without incurring interest charges if repaid according to terms.

promotions.title: Mox Zone on The Club Year-Round Deals
promotions.highlight: 🛍️ Enjoy year-round exclusive deals on The Club
promotions.description: Mox Zone is now available on The Club, offering year-round exclusive deals for Mox customers. Permanent access to special discounts and promotions when shopping on The Club platform.

promotions.title: Spend & Save Double Rewards
promotions.highlight: 💰 20% cash rebate from 5 hot merchants plus savings rewards
promotions.description: Earn 20% cash rebate on spending across 5 designated hot merchants. Additionally, earn extra rewards from savings activities, creating a double reward structure from both spending and saving.

promotions.title: 0% Foreign Currency Transaction Fee
promotions.highlight: 💳 Enjoy 0% foreign currency transaction fees on overseas spending
promotions.description: Mox Credit Card users can enjoy 0% foreign currency transaction fees when spending abroad or on foreign currency transactions. This includes both foreign currency conversion fees and cross-border HKD transaction fees.
promotions.quota: Available to all Mox Credit Card users

promotions.title: HKT Bills Autopay Rewards

promotions.title: HKT Shop Cash Rewards

promotions.title: Instant Earnings on Deposits
promotions.highlight: 💰 HKD1,400 Cash Rewards for HKT shop purchases
promotions.description: Shop at HKT to receive HKD1,400 in Cash Rewards. This promotion rewards customers for making purchases at HKT retail locations or online store with significant cash incentives.

promotions.title: Instant Interest on Time Deposits

promotions.title: Mox Credit Card Miles Rewards Scheme
promotions.highlight: ✈️ For all spending HKD4=1 mile + 0 Limits + 0% FX Fees
promotions.description: Earn 1 mile for every HKD4 spent with your Mox Credit Card with no earning limits. Additionally, enjoy 0% foreign exchange fees on international purchases, making this ideal for travelers.

promotions.title: Daily Interest Calculation
promotions.highlight: 💸 Interest on savings calculated and credited to your account daily
promotions.description: Mox calculates and credits interest to your Mox Account daily, allowing your savings to grow faster. This is a permanent feature of Mox accounts with no end date or special eligibility requirements.

promotions.title: Mox Invest Trading Services
promotions.highlight: 📈 Trade HK and US stocks including fractional shares with low fees
promotions.description: Mox is the first digital bank allowing customers to trade in both HK and US stocks, including fractional shares. Invest with low fees in stocks and funds with the security and advantages of a bank.

promotions.title: USD Savings Rate
promotions.highlight: 💵 1% p.a. interest on USD savings with no strings attached
promotions.description: Starting 1 March 2025, enjoy 1% p.a. interest on your USD savings with no strings attached. Interest is calculated and credited to your account daily, allowing you to watch your savings grow every day.

promotions.title: Mox Credit FPS Payments
promotions.highlight: ⚡ Pay with Mox Credit via FPS for transfers and bill payments
promotions.description: Use your Mox Credit to make payments via FPS, making daily transfers or paying bills effortlessly. This feature is automatically unlocked when your credit limit is approved, with no extra documents required.

promotions.title: Account Opening in 3 Minutes with No Minimum Balance
promotions.highlight: ⚡ Open your account in as fast as 3 minutes with no minimum balance requirement
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank offers rapid account opening that can be completed in as little as 3 minutes for standard cases where no additional information or documents are required. This is a permanent feature of the bank's digital banking service, available to all customers. The actual account opening time may vary depending on individual circumstances and documentation needs.

promotions.title: 24/7 Full Banking Services on Mobile App
promotions.highlight: 🕐 Access full banking services 24 hours a day, 7 days a week through the mobile app
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank provides round-the-clock banking capability in a single mobile application, allowing customers to manage their accounts anytime. This permanent feature supports all core banking functions including deposits, transfers, and currency exchange without time restrictions.

promotions.title: Banking Services for Hong Kong Residents and Visitors
promotions.highlight: 🏦 Full banking services available to both Hong Kong residents and visiting customers
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank provides comprehensive banking services supporting both Hong Kong residents and visitors physically present in Hong Kong. Services include deposits, local transfers, cross-border remittances, and currency exchange. This is a permanent service feature offering equal access to all eligible customers. Banking services are only available to visiting customers who are physically present within Hong Kong.
promotions.quota: Hong Kong residents and visiting customers in Hong Kong

promotions.title: Money Market Fund with Zero Subscription and Redemption Fees
promotions.highlight: ⚡ Redeem money market funds with T+0 same-day settlement to your bank account
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank offers same-day redemption (T+0) for money market funds, with proceeds credited to the customer's bank account. This permanent feature provides maximum liquidity for money market fund investments with no expiration date or special eligibility requirements.

promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank provides permanent free Level 1 real-time Hong Kong stock market data to all customers. This includes 24-hour unlimited real-time price quotes and market indices. Customers who have not activated stock investment services will see 15-minute delayed data instead.

promotions.highlight: 🌍 Trade US stocks for 16 hours daily including pre-market, regular, and after-hours sessions
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank supports extended US stock trading hours with pre-market trading from 4:00-9:30 AM ET, regular trading from 9:30 AM-4:00 PM ET, and after-hours trading from 4:00-8:00 PM ET. This 16-hour total trading window is a permanent feature allowing customers greater flexibility in US market access compared to regular market hours.

promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank offers permanent zero platform fees for Hong Kong stock trading. Commission is charged at 0.15% per transaction with a minimum fee of HKD 50. This is a core feature of the investment account with no expiry date or special eligibility conditions.

promotions.title: Industry Trend Analysis and Stock Comparison Tools
promotions.highlight: 🔍 View industry heat maps and compare individual stocks with peers in real-time
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank offers industry trend analysis and individual stock comparison tools as permanent service features. Customers can see industry heat maps to understand sector movements and compare individual stocks against industry peers. This includes tracking company performance data to assess stock trends and competitive positioning. These analysis tools are available at no additional cost to all investment customers.

promotions.title: Time Deposits for Steady and Reliable Growth
promotions.highlight: 📊 Time deposits offering flexible terms to support steady and reliable growth of funds
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank offers time deposit products designed to support customers with steady and reliable income growth. These deposits complement the bank's current account offerings, providing customers with flexible options to allocate and grow their funds. Time deposits are a permanent product feature available to all eligible customers. Combined with current deposits, customers can flexibly arrange their funds to earn interest.

promotions.title: Professional Investment Analysis Tools with 40+ Technical Indicators
promotions.highlight: 📈 Access to over 40 advanced technical indicators to analyze market movements
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank provides access to advanced technical analysis tools with over 40 technical indicators as a permanent platform feature. These tools help customers grasp market opportunities and make informed trading decisions. The indicators span from macro-level indices to micro-level data analysis, enabling comprehensive market assessment. All technical analysis tools are included at no additional charge.

promotions.title: Fund Investment with Multiple Fund Categories and Zero Platform Fee
promotions.highlight: 🎯 Access to global top-tier fund companies with multi-dimensional ranking and selection
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank offers investment in multiple fund categories including money market funds, fixed income/bond funds, stock funds, and mixed funds with zero platform fees. The subscription fees vary by fund type: money market funds at 0%, bond funds at 0.5%, and mixed/stock funds at 1%. Customers can access funds across HK stocks, US stocks, and global markets with professional ranking tools to help with fund selection. Fast account opening in 3 minutes is available for existing savings account holders.
promotions.cost: Varies: Money market 0%, Bond funds 0.5%, Stock/Mixed funds 1%

promotions.title: Multiple Order Types Including Stop-Loss Limit Orders
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Use multiple order types including limit orders and stop-loss orders for flexible trading
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank provides multiple order placement options including limit orders and stop-loss limit orders as permanent trading features. These flexible order types help customers manage market volatility risk and execute strategies without fear of price swings. Customers can choose the most appropriate order type for their trading needs. All order types are available at standard trading fees with no additional charges.

promotions.title: T+0 Same-Day Redemption for Money Market Funds

promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank offers same-day (T+0) redemption for money market funds as a permanent feature. While the redemption transaction is generally confirmed within 1-3 business days, the funds credited to your bank account can arrive as soon as the same day in most cases. This fast redemption capability applies to all customers holding money market funds indefinitely and provides flexibility to access invested capital quickly.

promotions.title: Discounted Subscription Fee for Mixed and Equity Funds
promotions.highlight: 📈 Subscribe to mixed and equity funds with a standard 1% subscription fee
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank offers subscription to mixed funds and equity funds with a fixed 1% subscription fee as a core product feature. This standard fee applies to all mixed asset class funds and stock-based funds available on the platform. No time-limited promotion or special conditions apply — this is the permanent subscription fee structure.

promotions.title: Low Minimum Investment Threshold for US Money Market Funds
promotions.highlight: 💵 Start investing with as little as HKD 100 or USD 20 minimum investment
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank offers low barriers to entry for fund investing, with money market funds requiring a minimum investment of as low as HKD 100 or approximately USD 20. This allows customers with limited capital to begin building a diversified investment portfolio without a large upfront commitment. The low minimum applies permanently across the platform's fund offerings.

promotions.title: Multiple Fund Investment Options with Rankings and Filters
promotions.highlight: 🎯 Choose from hand-picked global top-tier funds with multi-dimensional ranking and filtering options
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank curates and offers funds from leading global fund companies with multi-dimensional ranking tools to help customers select funds aligned with their investment goals. Customers can filter by asset class, dividend policy, trading currency, risk level, and fund company. This permanent feature simplifies fund selection for both novice and experienced investors.
promotions.cost: Varies by fund type (0% for money market, 0.5% for bond, 1% for equity/mixed funds)

This permanent pricing structure is designed for transparency and cost control.

Money market funds invest primarily in short-term deposits and high-quality money market instruments with relatively low volatility and uncertainty risk.

promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank offers US stock trading with a commission rate of USD 0.012 per share with a minimum charge of USD 7.88 per transaction. There is no platform fee for trading US stocks through Ping An Digital Bank.

promotions.title: 3-Minute Investment Account Opening for Existing Customers
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Open a bank account in as fast as 3 minutes
promotions.description: PADB offers an expedited account opening process that can be completed in as little as 3 minutes for standard applications where no additional documents or information are required. This digital onboarding service is available to both Hong Kong residents and visitors physically present in Hong Kong. The quick account opening process features no minimum balance requirement.
promotions.quota: Hong Kong residents and visitors physically present in Hong Kong

promotions.title: Discounted Subscription Fee for Bond Funds
promotions.highlight: 🔽 Reduced subscription fees on investment funds
promotions.description: PADB offers discounted subscription fees for various types of funds. Money market funds come with no subscription fees, bond funds are available at a reduced subscription fee of 0.5%, while mixed and equity funds have a competitive subscription fee of 1%. This pricing structure makes investing in funds more accessible and cost-effective compared to traditional channels, which typically charge 2-3% for fund subscriptions.
promotions.cost: Money market funds: Free; Bond funds: 0.5%; Mixed and equity funds: 1%

promotions.title: Global Investment Access Platform
promotions.highlight: 🌎 Access global markets with HK stocks, US stocks, funds and money market funds
promotions.description: PADB provides comprehensive global investment access through its integrated platform, featuring Hong Kong stocks, US stocks, funds, and money market funds. The service allows customers to easily diversify their investments across different asset classes and global markets. Users benefit from a seamless experience switching between banking and investment functions, with all capabilities available in a single account.
promotions.cost: Free platform access; trading fees apply for specific investment products

promotions.title: Banking Services for Hong Kong Visitors
promotions.highlight: 🌏 Banking services available to visitors physically in Hong Kong
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank offers banking services to visitors who are physically present in Hong Kong. This allows non-residents to access banking services during their stay in the city.
promotions.quota: Only for visitors physically present in Hong Kong

promotions.title: Hong Kong Stock Trading Commission Rate
promotions.highlight: 🆓 Trade Hong Kong stocks with no platform fee
promotions.description: PADB offers Hong Kong stock trading with no platform fees, allowing investors to trade more cost-effectively. The service includes real-time market indices to help investors determine optimal trading timing. Customers only pay a competitive commission of 0.15% with a minimum charge of HKD 50 per transaction.
promotions.cost: 0.15% commission with minimum HKD 50 per trade; no platform fee

promotions.title: Banking Security × Brokerage-Grade Trading Power
promotions.highlight: 🔐 Enjoy bank-level security with professional trading capabilities
promotions.description: PADB combines robust banking security with professional brokerage-grade trading capabilities in a dual-strength investment account. Customers can effortlessly switch between investments and deposits, enabling agile portfolio management in changing market conditions. The service provides diversification options and smooth execution without friction, allowing users to stay ahead of market changes.
promotions.cost: Free account access; trading fees apply for specific investment transactions

promotions.highlight: 🌏 Banking services available for both HK residents and visitors

promotions.title: Low Minimum Investment for Money Market Funds
promotions.highlight: 💵 Invest in money market funds from just $20 USD
promotions.description: PADB offers USD money market funds with a low entry threshold of just 20 USD. These funds provide a relatively stable investment option with lower volatility and uncertainty compared to other investment products.

promotions.title: Time Deposit Account
promotions.highlight: 💰 Steady and reliable growth with time deposits
promotions.description: Time deposit accounts that support steady and reliable growth. Flexibly arrange your funds to earn interest with both current and time deposit accounts.

promotions.highlight: 💰 Start investing with as little as HK$100 or US$20

promotions.title: Time Deposit Growth
promotions.highlight: 💰 Steady and reliable growth through time deposits
promotions.description: PAObank offers time deposit services to help customers achieve steady and reliable growth on their savings. This service provides a secure way to earn interest on funds deposited for a fixed period.

promotions.title: Multiple Insurance Options
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Diverse insurance options including life, savings, motor, home, and travel
promotions.description: PAObank offers a comprehensive range of insurance products including life, savings, motor, home, and travel insurance. Applications can be completed through the bank's mobile app, with personalized advisory services available for wealth and legacy planning.

promotions.title: Low Minimum Fund Subscription
promotions.highlight: 💵 Invest in funds with as little as USD 20
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank allows customers to subscribe to money market funds with a minimum amount as low as USD 20. This low entry barrier makes fund investment accessible to more customers regardless of their investment capital.

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Unlimited $0 Fund Subscription and Switching Fees
promotions.highlight: 💰 Unlimited $0 subscription fees and switching fees on all funds
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers unlimited $0 subscription and switching fees on all funds through their partnership with world-leading fund companies. This is a permanent feature allowing customers to flexibly allocate their funds without incurring subscription or switching charges. Customers can build a diversified passive income stream and make investing stress-free. No registration or special eligibility conditions apply—this benefit is available to all customers using WeLab Bank's fund investment services.

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Personal Loan 'R-Friend Referral' Campaign
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Earn HKD 800 cash reward for each successful personal loan referral, up to HKD 8,000 maximum
promotions.description: WeLab Bank customers can earn HKD 800 referral reward each time they successfully refer a friend or relative to apply for WeLab Bank Personal Instalment Loan or Debt Consolidation Loan using their unique referral code and the referee draws down the loan within 7 days after approval. The maximum referral reward during the campaign period is HKD 8,000 (up to 10 successful referrals). Both existing and new WeLab Bank customers can be referees. The referral reward will be credited into your HKD Core Account on or before 31 July 2026. If you request to close your account within one year upon receiving the referral reward, WeLab Bank reserves the right to deduct the equivalent credited amount or collect it through other means. All WeLab Bank customers are eligible to participate by making referrals with their unique referral codes.
promotions.quota: All WeLab Bank customers; existing or new referee customers

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Personal Loan Cash Rebate up to HKD 23,888
promotions.highlight: 💵 Earn up to HKD 23,888 cash rebate when you borrow HKD 150,001 or more with 24-month tenor
promotions.description: Successful WeLab Bank Personal Loan applicants can enjoy up to HKD 23,888 cash rebate if they meet the following conditions: the approved loan amount is HKD 150,001 or more, the loan tenor is 24 months or more, and the loan is drawn down within 7 days after approval. The cash rebate amount will be credited directly into your HKD Core Account on or before 31 October 2026. This promotion applies to all customers who successfully apply for and draw down a WeLab Bank Personal Loan (Personal Instalment Loan or Debt Consolidation Loan) during the campaign period.
promotions.quota: All customers with approved loan amount HKD 150,001 or more
promotions.cost: Minimum approved loan amount HKD 150,001 with 24-month tenor

promotions.title: Investment Fund Cash Rewards - Up to HKD 4,000
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 1,500 cash reward when you invest HKD 20,000 or more in funds
promotions.description: Eligible customers can earn up to HKD 1,500 cash reward (equivalent to 4.87% one-month annual rate) by subscribing to funds through Featured Fund Services or GoWealth Digital Wealth Advisory. To qualify, you must have successfully opened a valid Core Account with WeLab Bank on or before 31 March 2026, maintain your Core Account and Investment Account between 9 April 2026 and 21 April 2026, and successfully subscribe to any fund with an investment amount not less than HKD 20,000 (WeLab Money Plus and Money Market Funds are also applicable), with an aggregate investment amount not less than HKD 100,000 or its equivalent by the cut-off time. The cash reward will be credited to your HKD Core Account on or before a specified date. This promotion is open to new customers who opened accounts on or before 31 March 2026.
promotions.quota: New customers who opened accounts on or before 31 March 2026
promotions.cost: Minimum HKD 20,000 per subscription; aggregate HKD 100,000 or equivalent

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Tesla Unsecured Loan Referral Reward HKD 800
promotions.highlight: 🚗 Earn HKD 800 cash reward when you refer a friend to apply for Tesla Unsecured Loan
promotions.description: WeLab Bank customers can earn HKD 800 cash reward by successfully referring friends to apply for and drawdown Tesla Unsecured Loan using their referral code. The reward structure mirrors the Personal Loan referral program, allowing customers to earn rewards for each successful referral during the campaign period. The referral reward will be credited to your HKD Core Account on or before 31 July 2026. Both existing and new WeLab Bank customers can be referees, and the loan must be drawn down within 7 days after approval to qualify.
promotions.quota: All WeLab Bank customers; existing or new referee customers

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Global Wallet Competitive Exchange Rates
promotions.highlight: 🌍 Access the best FX rates in town for international transfers and currency exchanges
promotions.description: WeLab Bank leverages AI and technology to offer customers the best foreign exchange rates compared to other retail banks in Hong Kong. This comparison is based on exchange rates collected from 28 retail banks' websites, online banking, or mobile banking platforms as of approximately 2:30 pm on 14 January 2026, excluding banks that do not publish FX rates through these channels. The rates include any fees charged by banks for FX transactions to facilitate a transparent comparison. This is an ongoing product feature available to all WeLab Bank customers with no end date or special eligibility conditions.

promotions.title: WeLab Global Wallet Debit Card - $0 Foreign Currency Transaction Fee
promotions.highlight: 💳 Global debit card for domestic and international transactions
promotions.description: The WeLab Global Wallet Debit Card is linked to the WeLab Global Wallet and allows customers to make purchases both domestically and internationally. The card enables customers to spend in multiple currencies with competitive exchange rates, avoiding traditional foreign transaction fees that might be charged by other banks. Customers can manage their debit card settings, including security features and spending limits, through the WeLab Bank app. The WeLab Global Wallet Debit Card is designed to provide a seamless spending experience for customers, particularly those who travel frequently or make international purchases online. The card is part of WeLab Bank's suite of products aimed at simplifying global financial management.

promotions.title: Tesla Customer Exclusive Personal Instalment Loan Offer
promotions.highlight: 💼 Flexible personal loans for various financial needs
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's Personal Instalment Loan provides customers with flexible financing options for various personal needs. The loan can be used for a wide range of purposes, from home improvements to education expenses or travel. The product features competitive interest rates and flexible repayment terms to suit different customer needs. Applicants can apply through the WeLab Bank app with a streamlined digital application process. During promotional periods, customers may be eligible for cash rebates when meeting specific criteria such as minimum loan amounts and tenor requirements. This loan product is a core offering in WeLab Bank's suite of financing solutions designed to meet customers' diverse financial needs.

promotions.title: GoSave 2.0 4% p.a. Time Deposit for New Customers
promotions.highlight: 💰 Competitive interest rates for time deposits
promotions.description: GoSave 2.0 is WeLab Bank's time deposit product offering competitive interest rates for customers. The service allows customers to lock in funds for a fixed period to earn higher interest compared to regular savings accounts. According to an example in the website, new customers could open two 1-month HKD GoSave 2.0 time deposits with 4% annual interest rate, one with HKD 80,000 and another with HKD 200,000. The combined interest for these deposits would amount to approximately HKD 920.55 (calculated as (HKD 80,000 × 4% ÷ 365 × 30) + (HKD 200,000 × 4% ÷ 365 × 30)). GoSave 2.0 is part of WeLab Bank's suite of savings products designed to help customers maximize their earnings.

promotions.title: WeLab Money Plus Investment Service
promotions.highlight: 💰 Money market fund with returns up to 4.4% in the past year
promotions.description: WeLab Money Plus (also referred to as WeLab 閒智寶) is a money market fund offered through WeLab Bank's Featured Fund Services. It provides returns similar to time deposits but without locking in the term. According to the platform, it has achieved returns of up to 4.4% in the past year. The fund is designed for those seeking liquidity while still earning competitive returns. Instructions submitted before the trading day cut-off time (9:00 AM Hong Kong time) qualify for same-day settlement. The Value US Dollar Money Market Fund B Class (HKD) (Accumulation) specifically showed a one-year return of up to 4.43% and a total return of 10.48% since its establishment on November 22, 2023.
promotions.cost: Minimum investment of HKD 100 or USD 15

promotions.title: Apple Products Subscribe+ Program
promotions.highlight: 🍎 Installment plan specifically for Apple product purchases
promotions.description: The Subscribe+ for Apple Products program (also called Apple 產品好賞分期計劃 in Chinese) is a specialized installment plan offered by WeLab Bank for customers who wish to purchase Apple products. This financing option allows customers to spread the cost of Apple devices over multiple payments, making premium technology more accessible. The program is specifically designed for Apple products and offers competitive payment terms. Customers can apply for this financing through the WeLab Bank app. This installment plan is part of WeLab Bank's partnership with Apple and reflects their strategic collaborations with leading technology companies.

promotions.title: Policy Loan Service
promotions.highlight: 📝 Loans using insurance policies as collateral
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers Policy Loans that allow customers to use their existing insurance policies as collateral to obtain financing. This loan option enables policyholders to access liquidity from their insurance assets without surrendering their policies or losing coverage. The Policy Loan product is designed for customers who have built up cash value in their insurance policies and need access to funds for various purposes. The loan amount is typically based on the cash surrender value of the policy. This financing option is part of WeLab Bank's comprehensive loan offerings, which include personal instalment loans, card debt consolidation loans, and specialized financing solutions.

promotions.title: Money Safe Feature
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Enhanced security features for your funds
promotions.description: Money Safe (智安存 in Chinese) is a security feature offered by WeLab Bank designed to provide enhanced protection for customers' funds. This feature helps safeguard customer deposits against unauthorized access and transactions. Money Safe is part of WeLab Bank's commitment to providing secure banking services in the digital environment. The service likely includes various security protocols and measures to ensure that customers' funds remain protected. This security feature complements WeLab Bank's digital-first approach to banking, providing customers with peace of mind while conducting their financial activities through the WeLab Bank app.

promotions.title: Learn Now Pay Later Program
promotions.highlight: 📚 Flexible financing option for educational expenses
promotions.description: The Learn Now Pay Later Program is a financing solution offered by WeLab Bank that allows customers to pay for educational expenses over time. This program enables customers to access educational opportunities immediately while spreading the cost over a more manageable payment schedule. The financing option is designed to make education more accessible by reducing the upfront financial burden. Customers can apply for this loan program through the WeLab Bank app. The Learn Now Pay Later Program is part of WeLab Bank's diverse loan offerings, which include personal instalment loans, card debt consolidation loans, and other specialized financing options.

promotions.title: Card Debt Consolidation Loan
promotions.highlight: 💳 Consolidate high-interest credit card debt into a single loan
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers a Card Debt Consolidation Loan that helps customers combine multiple high-interest credit card debts into a single, potentially lower-interest loan. This product is designed to simplify debt management by consolidating various credit card balances into one monthly payment, potentially at a lower interest rate. The consolidation can help customers save on interest payments and better manage their finances with a clearer repayment schedule. Customers can apply for this loan through the WeLab Bank app, with the potential to qualify for cash rebates when meeting certain criteria during promotional periods. This loan product is part of WeLab Bank's loan offerings aimed at helping customers better manage their financial obligations.

promotions.title: Featured Funds Services with Over 170 Funds
promotions.highlight: 🌐 Access to over 170 mutual funds from top global fund houses
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's Featured Funds Service provides access to more than 170 mutual funds from top global fund houses. The service features a user-friendly interface that showcases popular investment ideas, allowing customers to invest in mutual funds, dividend funds, bond funds, and more with just one click. Investment can start from as low as HKD 100 or USD 15, making fund investment more accessible. The service displays various fund categories like high-yield funds with annual returns up to 7.6%, global income funds with returns up to 6.4%, and conservative dividend funds with returns up to 4.0%, among others. This ongoing service allows customers to easily track market trends and make informed investment decisions.
promotions.cost: 0.1% monthly platform fee on total fund holdings

promotions.title: GoWealth Digital Wealth Advisory
promotions.highlight: 🤖 AI-powered investment advisory service with personalized portfolio recommendations
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's Digital Wealth Advisory Service, branded as 'GoWealth', provides personalized investment portfolio recommendations based on individual investment goals and personal situations. The service allows customers to set investment objectives, including investment period and one-time or monthly investment amounts. The system then generates tailored portfolio recommendations. After accepting the advice, the system executes the initial investment and sets up automatic monthly investments according to the customer's specifications. The service includes various notifications about investment progress, though these are not investment advice. Customers can monitor progress and adjust goals as needed through the WeLab Bank app.
promotions.cost: 0.1% monthly platform fee on total fund holdings

promotions.title: Quick Account Opening Service
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Open a bank account in as fast as 2 minutes
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers a quick account opening service that allows new customers to open a bank account in as little as 2 minutes. This digital onboarding process enables customers to quickly access WeLab's banking services, including investments, without the need to visit a physical branch. After completing the account opening process, customers can immediately begin using their Core Account and activate additional services like the Investment Account. The service is designed to make banking more accessible and convenient through digital channels. Actual account opening time may vary depending on different factors.

promotions.title: Smart Finance with AI Technology
promotions.highlight: 🤖 Highly personalized banking experience powered by Generative AI and AI Agents
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers a smart banking experience powered by AI technology to help customers grow their wealth. The bank has established an AI-first strategic partnership with Google to apply artificial intelligence across operations, product design, and marketing. This technology allows WeLab Bank to provide highly personalized financial services for savings, loans, and investments. Customers can manage global debit cards, international transfers, and access loans all through one app, freeing up their time for other priorities.

promotions.title: AI-First Digital Banking Services
promotions.highlight: 🤖 Highly personalized customer experiences using Generative AI and AI Agents
promotions.description: WeLab Bank provides AI-powered banking services through its strategic partnership with Google, applying artificial intelligence across operations, product design, and marketing. This service offers a personalized banking experience tailored to individual customer needs and preferences. Customers can access intelligent financial tools for savings, loans, and investments designed to help them save and earn more efficiently. This always-on AI-first approach represents WeLab's core commitment to delivering smarter banking.

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Digital Wealth Advisory Service
promotions.highlight: 🤖 AI-powered personalized investment portfolio management
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's GoWealth Digital Wealth Advisory is a permanent service that offers personalized investment portfolio recommendations using AI technology in partnership with Allianz Global Investors. Customers can set investment goals including investment period and contribution amounts, and the system provides tailored portfolio recommendations. After accepting the recommendation, the system will make the initial investment and continue with automated monthly investments based on the customer's settings. The service provides ongoing notifications about investment progress and allows customers to monitor and adjust their goals as needed. This is not a discretionary asset management service, and the recommendations do not guarantee investment outcomes.
promotions.cost: 0.1% monthly platform fee on fund holdings
